enonce.texte:
You are preparing your final project for the English Intermediate to Advanced course. Your project should demonstrate your ability to use advanced language skills in a real-world context.

Task: Create a detailed outline for your final project. Your project can be one of the following:

  • A persuasive presentation on a topic of your choice (e.g., climate change, education reform, technology impact).
  • A business proposal for a new product or service.
  • A creative writing piece (short story, personal narrative, or poem) that explores an abstract concept (e.g., freedom, identity, resilience).

Your outline must include:

  • Introduction: Hook, context, and thesis/purpose statement.
  • Body: 3-5 main points with supporting details and evidence.
  • Conclusion: Summary and call to action or reflection.
  • Language goals: List at least 5 advanced vocabulary words or 3 complex grammar structures you will use.

questions.texte: Write a detailed outline for your final project. Include all the elements mentioned above.
questions.reponse: Réponse ouverte. Exemple de structure : Introduction: 'In today's digital age, social media has transformed the way we communicate. However, it also poses significant challenges to mental health. This presentation will explore the dual nature of social media.' Body: 1. Positive aspects (connectivity, information access). 2. Negative effects (anxiety, misinformation). 3. Solutions (digital literacy, time management). Conclusion: 'By understanding both sides, we can use social media responsibly.' Language goals: 'intangible, paradox, perspective, furthermore, nevertheless, conditional forms.'

enonce.texte:
You have been invited to give a presentation at an international conference on 'Innovation in Education.' You need to confirm your participation and propose a specific topic.

Task: Write a professional email to the conference organizer (Mr. John Smith) that:

  • Confirms your attendance.
  • Proposes a specific presentation topic and explains its relevance.
  • Asks about the time allocated for your presentation.
  • Inquires about technical equipment available.
  • Mentions that you will be submitting your slides one week before the event.

questions.texte: Write a complete, well-structured professional email.
questions.reponse: Exemple de réponse : Subject: Confirmation of Participation - [Your Name] - Innovation in Education Conference. Dear Mr. Smith, I am writing to confirm my participation in the upcoming conference on Innovation in Education. I would like to propose a presentation titled 'Integrating Technology into the Classroom: Challenges and Opportunities.' This topic is highly relevant as educators worldwide are adapting to digital learning. Could you please inform me about the duration of the presentation slot? Additionally, I would like to know what technical equipment will be available (e.g., projector, microphone). I will be submitting my presentation slides one week before the event. I look forward to contributing to this important event. Yours sincerely, [Your Name].

enonce.texte: Complete the following exercises to demonstrate your mastery of advanced grammar and vocabulary.

questions.texte: Complete the sentence with the correct form of the verb: 'By the end of this year, we ______ (complete) the construction of the new bridge.'
Rewrite the sentence in reported speech: 'I am writing a novel,' she said.
questions.reponse: She said that she was writing a novel.

questions.texte: Convert the sentence to passive voice: 'The government will announce the new policy tomorrow.'
questions.reponse: The new policy will be announced by the government tomorrow.

questions.texte: Replace the underlined verb with a suitable phrasal verb: 'The meeting was postponed until next week.'

enonce.texte:
You are required to deliver a 5-minute professional presentation on a topic related to your field of study or work. The presentation will be evaluated on the following criteria:

  • Structure: Clear introduction, body, and conclusion.
  • Language use: Advanced vocabulary, correct grammar, and cohesive devices.
  • Delivery: Eye contact, body language, and vocal variety.
  • Content: Relevance, accuracy, and depth of information.
  • Engagement: Ability to connect with the audience and handle questions.

questions.texte: Prepare a detailed script for your 5-minute presentation. Include an introduction, 3 main points, and a conclusion. Also, list the visual aids you will use.
questions.reponse: Réponse ouverte. Exemple de script : Introduction: 'Good morning, everyone. Today, I would like to discuss the impact of artificial intelligence on the job market.' Body: 1. 'Firstly, AI is automating routine tasks, which leads to job displacement in some sectors.' 2. 'Secondly, AI creates new opportunities in fields like data science and robotics.' 3. 'Finally, we must adapt by reskilling the workforce.' Conclusion: 'In conclusion, while AI presents challenges, it also offers immense potential for innovation. I believe we can embrace this change with the right strategies.' Visual aids: Slides with key points, graphs showing job trends, and images of AI applications.

sousQuestions.texte: What strategies will you use to engage your audience during the presentation?
sousQuestions.reponse: Examples: Start with a thought-provoking question, use anecdotes, incorporate interactive polls, and maintain eye contact. Ask for questions at the end and respond thoughtfully.

enonce.texte:
Reflect on your progress throughout the English Intermediate to Advanced course. Identify your strengths and areas for improvement.

Task: Write a self-assessment report (250-300 words) that includes:

  • A summary of your achievements in grammar, vocabulary, and communication skills.
  • An analysis of your weaknesses (e.g., pronunciation, writing coherence, etc.).
  • A specific action plan with at least 3 concrete steps to improve your English.
  • A timeline for achieving your goals.

questions.reponse: Réponse ouverte. Exemple de structure : 'During this course, I have significantly improved my understanding of complex grammar structures, such as conditionals and passive voice. My vocabulary has expanded, and I can now use idioms and phrasal verbs more confidently. However, I still struggle with pronunciation, particularly with the /θ/ and /ð/ sounds. I also find it challenging to structure long essays coherently. To address these issues, I plan to (1) practice pronunciation daily using online resources, (2) write a short essay every week and seek feedback, and (3) read academic articles to improve my writing style. I aim to achieve these goals within three months, with the help of my teacher and language partners.'

enonce.texte:
You are the manager of a company that is facing a decline in employee morale and productivity. You have been asked to propose a solution to the board of directors.

Task: Write a proposal (400-500 words) that:

  • Analyzes the problem and its causes.
  • Proposes a specific solution (e.g., implementing a wellness program, flexible work hours, team-building activities).
  • Uses persuasive language and advanced vocabulary to convince the board.
  • Includes an estimated budget and expected outcomes.

questions.texte: Write a proposal to the board.
questions.reponse: Réponse ouverte. Exemple de structure : 'Subject: Proposal to Address Employee Morale and Productivity. Dear Board Members, Over the past six months, our company has experienced a noticeable decline in employee morale and productivity. This issue stems from long working hours, lack of recognition, and limited opportunities for professional growth. To address this, I propose the implementation of a comprehensive Employee Wellness Program. This program would include flexible working hours, monthly team-building activities, and a recognition system for outstanding performance. The estimated cost is $10,000, which is a modest investment compared to the potential benefits. I am confident that this initiative will boost morale, increase productivity by at least 15%, and reduce staff turnover. I urge you to consider this proposal and approve the necessary resources. Sincerely, [Your Name].'
